name: public-records
description: Find what a US public body (county, city, school district, special district) bought, decided and who changed roles, from its own meeting records: resolve the body, find its meetings (portal adapters first), map them, read minutes item by item with a cheap judge, and answer with coverage.

browser.title: Browser for portals that refuse plain HTTP
browser.description: playwright: a Chromium of its own (installed once, the tools say how); openclaw: the browser your OpenClaw runs; or a Chrome remote-debugging address such as http://127.0.0.1:9222

jev.title: Jev, the cheap judge (optional)
jev.description: off, or api:vercel to label documents with Jev through the Vercel AI Gateway (needs the key below), so the agent reads less

ai_gateway_api_key.title: Vercel AI Gateway key (only for Jev)
ai_gateway_api_key.description: Kept in your system's credential store; leave empty when Jev is off

search.title: Web search for finding a body's site and meetings
search.description: Providers tried in order, comma-separated: mcp:<url> (any MCP search server), api:parallel or api:exa (your key below), agent (Claude's own web search), off

scrape.title: Page reader for pages a plain fetch cannot read
scrape.description: Tried in order: mcp:<url> (any MCP scrape server), api:firecrawl (your Firecrawl key), api:treg (Firecrawl through treg, your treg token), off (plain fetch and the browser only)

parallel_api_key.title: Parallel key (only for api:parallel)
parallel_api_key.description: Kept in your system's credential store; leave empty when unused

exa_api_key.title: Exa key (only for api:exa)
exa_api_key.description: Kept in your system's credential store; leave empty when unused

firecrawl_api_key.title: Firecrawl key (only for api:firecrawl)
firecrawl_api_key.description: Kept in your system's credential store; leave empty when unused

treg_token.title: treg token (only for api:treg)
treg_token.description: Kept in your system's credential store; leave empty when unused
